summary.zh-Hans: 西贡中央邮局的大厅两旁设有木制电话亭，墙上展示历史地图。
summary.en: The foyer of Saigon Central Post Office has wooden telephone booths along its sides and historic maps on the walls.

summary.zh-Hans: 阮惠步行街位于胡志明市，从市政厅一侧延伸至白藤码头一侧。
summary.en: Nguyễn Huệ is a walking street in Ho Chi Minh City, extending from City Hall toward Bạch Đằng Wharf.

summary.zh-Hans: 胡志明市的越南夹馅面包有多种馅料。一种烤猪肉版本将面包剖开，放入猪肉、黄瓜、香菜和腌胡萝卜。
summary.en: Bánh mì in Ho Chi Minh City comes with different fillings. One roast-pork version fills a split baguette with pork, cucumber, coriander and pickled carrot.

summary.zh-Hans: 碎米饭是胡志明市可见的米饭料理，可配烤猪排、黄瓜、腌菜和甜味鱼露。
summary.en: Cơm tấm is a broken-rice dish found in Ho Chi Minh City. It can be served with grilled pork, cucumber, pickles and sweetened fish sauce.
